content:
Apple TV (now $6.99/month for Black Friday) is about to bring back a beloved comedy from Ted Lasso and Shrinking’s creator, plus a new holiday special, documentary event series, and more. Here’s everything new coming to Apple TV in December.

Bad Monkey (season 2)

  • When: December 2
  • What: TV Show
  • Genre: Comedy

“Bad Monkey” hails from Ted Lasso and Shrinking creator Bill Lawrence. After Andrew Yancy (Vince Vaughn) witnesses the murder of Florida’s finest fixer, an ambitious state attorney pairs him up with a strait-laced forensic accountant to solve the crime. Eager to regain his detective’s badge, Yancy finds himself embroiled in a turf war between rival criminal organizations as he navigates a variety of Florida oddballs, including an erudite mob boss, his unhinged son and a hard-edged young woman who needs Yancy’s protection. Meanwhile, Yancy contends with his aging father; unresolved romantic tension with Dr. Rosa Campesino (Natalie Martinez), who launches her own investigation into a mysterious rash; and a bombastic animal relocation specialist whose business threatens the local environment.

Fraggle Rock: A Holiday Gift

  • When: December 4
  • What: Movie
  • Genre: Holiday Special

In this Fraggle Rock holiday special, Wembley is named Spirit Captain and sets out to spread cheer throughout the Rock. But when the Fraggles unknowingly take a cherished snow globe from Doc’s workshop, the holiday spirit begins to fade. Wembley must find the courage to return it, learning that kindness, giving and helping someone in need are the true gifts of the holidays.

TIMBERLAKE

  • When: December 11
  • What: TV Show
  • Genre: Documentary

“TIMBERLAKE” is an expansive portrait of the life and career of multi-hyphenate artist and icon Justin Timberlake. Raw, reflective and revealing, Timberlake sits down to discuss the triumphs that made him a global success, his personal perspective beyond the headlines and the challenges he’s faced behind the scenes. Directed by Academy Award winner Fisher Stevens (“The Cove,” “Beckham”), the series spans three decades of music and popular culture and features never-before-seen archival footage and exclusive interviews with family, friends and collaborators.

Classic movies including Shutter Island, Magnolia, Friends with Benefits, and more

  • When: December 1
  • What: Movies
  • Genre: Various

Apple TV recently started adding a bunch of classic movies for subscribers on the first day of each month. Titled added in November include Interstellar, Minority Report, Anchorman, Pulp Fiction, and more. So far, Apple has confirmed the following additions for December 1:

  • Shutter Island, the Martin Scorsese film with Leonardo DiCaprio
  • Friends with Benefits, starring Justin Timberlake and Mila Kunis
  • Magnolia, from director Paul Thomas Anderson
  • Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery, the Mike Myers comedy
  • The Karate Kid, the 1984 classic

New episodes: Stick, 12 12 12, Nocturne, and more

Apple TV also has new episodes coming in December for the following currently airing shows:

  • Where’s Wanda?: German dark comedy continues through December 9
  • Awkwafina: The Unlikely Cook: Documentary series continues through December 18
  • Nocturne: Liev Schreiber-starring serial killer thriller continues through December 25
  • 12 12 12: Heist series with Anthony Mackie, Jamie Dornan continues through December 25
  • Stick: Owen Wilson’s Ted Lasso-esque comedy continues through December 30

Which of Apple TV’s December releases are you looking forward to? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV is available for just $6.99/ month (over 50% off) for Black Friday.
